# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick is the JBL Charge 6.** It has an IP68 rating (dust-tight, rated for submersion) and 20 hours of battery, or 28 with Playtime Boost. It can also charge your phone. What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and Best Products did too. Current prices are about $130 at Walmart and $150 at Amazon.
- Buy and compare prices: [What Hi-Fi's Charge 6 listing](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- Also at [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/), listed at $150

## Other picks by need

- **Loudest, for pool parties: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS rated it the best waterproof speaker it tested. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts over 40 hours. Its sound is directional, so it's muffled if you're beside or behind it. It's pricey, and no price was given. [RTINGS review with buy links](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Sound in all directions: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** It's IP67, floats, and has a 360° design with about 15 hours of battery. Tom's Guide ranked it best overall, and RTINGS called it the best mid-range pick. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4.** It's about $65, IP67, floats, and gets about 14 hours of battery. It's small, so it's not very loud. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Easy to carry: JBL Grip.** It's about $100, IP68, and under a pound, and it fits in a backpack bottle pocket. Good Housekeeping's DJ tester picked it as best overall. The mesh can trap dust. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5.** It's about $40 and IP67, but it only lasts 8 to 10 hours. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Big and bassy on a budget: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus.** It's a 100 W speaker that floats, is rated IPX7, and runs up to 20 hours. It weighs 3.8 kg (about 8.4 lb), which is heavy for the beach. The list price is $249.99. Dealectric says the code AFSC20 took $49.99 off in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, making it $200. Check the final price at checkout. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) (an affiliate link). The smaller Soundcore Boom 2 floats but has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)).

## Tips
- Look for at least IPX7, and IP67 or IP68 for the beach, since the "6" also covers sand.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. RTINGS suggests rinsing with fresh water after use. Check your manual first, and dry the speaker fully before charging ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)).
- Keep the charging port flap closed around water.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocket-sized or party-loud, I can narrow this to one.
